optimizedDescription.value: Central aggregate owns change identity, lifecycle, artifacts, consent, verification, implementation tracking, history, and recovery.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change

## Rules
- Identity: immutable unique slug `name`, `createdAt`; reject whole-slug Windows devices `con|prn|aux|nul|com1..com9|lpt1..lpt9` case-insensitively. `ActorIdentity`: `name`, `email`, optional `provider`, `providerId`, `metadata`. `updatedAt >= createdAt`; omitted defaults to `createdAt`; `touchUpdatedAt(at = new Date())` advances it.
- Scope: mutable empty-valid canonical `specIds`; validate workspace on creation. Derived plural `workspaces` via `parseSpecId()`, never persisted/primary/indexed. `specDependsOn` is `CompileContext` highest-priority source; scope replacement prunes removed keys. Canonical additions/removals stale spec consent with precise diffs; reorder/duplicates do not. Scope edit alone never forces redesign.
- Lifecycle: `drafting → designing → ready → implementing ⇄ verifying → done → archivable → archiving`; `VALID_TRANSITIONS` authoritative. Legacy pending/approved states drain only. Gates `approvals.spec`/`approvals.signoff` default false; enabled gates retain `ready`/`done` until valid consent. Every state except `drafting` may return `designing`; application `designing → designing` neutral no-op; entity rejects real self-transition. `verifying → verifying` invalid.
- Retry: `done|signed-off|archivable → implementing|verifying` preserves unchanged artifacts/spec approval, invalidates active signoff. `archiving` permits manual `archivable|designing`; central reconciliation alone may apply `archiving → done` for required signoff recovery.
- `implementing → verifying` requires configured task completion. `verifying → implementing` only implementation repair; artifact/task revision returns `designing`. Lifecycle movement neither captures/completes nor invalidates verification.
- Artifacts: files use `missing|in-progress|complete|skipped|pending-review|drifted-pending-review`; aggregate precedence drifted > pending > complete > skipped > missing > in-progress. Only optional artifacts may skip; `complete|skipped` satisfy dependencies. `markComplete` reserved for validation; `markSkipped` for skip use case.
- Invalidation: structured `{artifacts: none|surgical|downstream|global, workflow: preserve|redesign}`; schema `ArtifactDag` expands downstream, excluding task artifacts from propagated drift review. `hasDrift` changes only for focused `artifact-drift`. Central reconciliation applies gate recovery: stale required spec consent → `designing`; stale required signoff → `done`; spec wins; never advance earlier state; idempotent.
- Consent: spec approval in `ready` requires validated reviewed artifacts, no drift, exact sorted canonical `specIds` + non-task artifact fingerprint. Signoff in `done` requires current artifacts, implementation fingerprint, valid verification. Projections persist `valid|stale|revoked`, actor/reason/time/cause; legacy incomplete evidence remains unknown. Hash equality never heals invalidity.
- Verification: explicit start from any active state refreshes tracking/resolution, checks files/links, captures non-task artifact + implementation baseline, appends `verification-attempt-started`; repeat supersedes active attempt, preserves history. Complete requires active attempt and exact fresh inputs, then records valid completion/event. Explicit invalidation requires reason. Operations never run tests or transition lifecycle.
- Implementation tracking: persist `implementationTrackingStartedAt`, project-relative files `open|resolved|ignored|removed`, confirmed spec/file links with optional symbols, explicit-vs-container-only intent. Activation idempotent; `removed` persists until refresh finds file; historical implementing fact gates autodetection.
- Fingerprints: deterministic complete-key maps. `text-v1` strips BOM, normalizes line endings/trailing horizontal whitespace/whitespace-only lines/final newline; no parsing, formatting, internal-whitespace, or symbol-range hashing. Binary byte-hash records algorithm. Missing/unreadable linked files fail. Task artifacts excluded from approval/verification fingerprints.
- History append-only; state derives latest `transitioned`. Archive only from `archivable`; failure records step/message/`commitStarted`; successful restore returns `archivable`, failed restore stays `archiving`. Draft moves active storage without lifecycle change; drafted changes read-only except restore/discard; discard irreversible and force-required after historical implementation.
- Entity owns facts; `evaluateLifecycleVerdict`/`projectArtifacts` own schema-DAG effective status, checks, blockers, hops, next action.

## Constraints
- History immutable; projection invalidity never self-heals. Artifact/file state and `hasDrift` authoritative; `validatedHash` baseline only.
- No primary workspace. Approval gates opt-in. Archive sources only `archivable|archiving`.
- Task completion derives schema `hasTasks`, task check, workflow requirements; task text is not approval evidence.
- Change domain I/O-free; application supplies schema, checks, fingerprints, actor, reconciliation, persistence.
